head: Expect the Hurricanes to fire from everywhere
paras: The Predators are 4-4-5. The Hurricanes have won three straight.
At home, Andrew Brunette likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Hurricanes’ third line. The Canes shoot a lot, and the Predators give up plenty.

items.text: Pyotr Kochetkov has won all nine of his starts this season, already the longest winning run to open a season by any goalie in franchise history.
Sebastian Aho has six goals in six games against Nashville since 2023-24.
The Hurricanes have been without Taylor Hall since Oct 13.
Jackson Blake and Nikolaj Ehlers have a point in five straight games.

NSH.head: A tough matchup for the Predators
NSH.body: Even though Nashville has home-ice advantage, Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators’ best way through is getting good looks.

CAR.head: Advantage, the Hurricanes
CAR.body: Even though Nashville has home-ice advantage, Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators’ way back in is getting good looks.

calls.head: A shadow job for Höglander, Wood and Forsberg
calls.body: At home, the Predators keep sending Forsberg’s line (Höglander, Wood and Forsberg) out against opponents’ third lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Andrew Brunette has been using this group as a checking line on opponents’ third lines. Tonight the Hurricanes’ third line is Martinook, Jankowski and Jarvis.

calls.head: Expect the Hurricanes to fire from everywhere
calls.body: Nashville has been giving up shots all season, and the Hurricanes rarely pass one up.

calls.head: Pond hockey
calls.body: The Hurricanes play some of the league’s fastest games, and so do the Predators. We think this one runs hotter than either team’s usual.
